name: Kashiwazaki Masami
source:
[url=/c11651]Miyabi[/url]'s uncle. Masami is the eldest son of the Kashiwazaki house and the manager of the Kashiwaya Ryokan. He's weak when he's facing [url=/c11700]Tooko[/url], his younger sister.

[Translated from the [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20080215012226/http://www.kid-game.co.jp/again/]Official Site[/url].]
